snippet.title: SIREN: Blood Curse Official Trailer
snippet.description:
True survival horror comes to the PS3 with SIREN: Blood Curse. Intense graphics, deadly Shibito zombies, and a gritty film-like graphical presentation add to the terror.

Siren Blood Curse. ©2008 Sony Computer Entertainment Inc.
